entry_points.text: Smaps middle handler tries THP fast path then per-page accounting with retry and yield; per-area show gathers from start, prints header, sizes, counters, eligibility and key plus flags.
Rollup open allocates context with seq and address space cleaning on failure; clear-refs handler clears soft-dirty or young/referenced; write validates command and walks whole space with bracketing.
Pagemap open binds address space after permission check; read streams entries by offset advancing it; release drops reference; control routes scan command and rejects others.
NUMA maps shows policy, backing markers and counters with node breakdown skipping gate area; no-MMU maps shows bounds, perms, offset, device, inode and path with open and release managing refs.
Thread-self resolves group and thread ids hierarchically with context allocation; uptime shows idle plus boot-adjusted time and version shows system identity as permanent single-show files.

exports.text: Publishes smaps, smaps rollup and clear-references file operations to the proc layer.
Publishes pagemap, NUMA maps and no-MMU maps tables plus vmcore callback registration.

hazards.text: Clear-refs are one to five plus sentinel; pagemap uses middle-sized chunks and entry-sized records; low 55 bits are frame with flags at 55-58 and 61-63 and value one signals end.
Scan categories union write-allowed, written, file, present, swapped, zero, huge, soft-dirty, guard and accessed; control accepts only write-protect-match and strict async-check flags.
NUMA skips gate area dropping and reacquiring protection; device needs 64-bit dumps rejecting overlap; scan faults on bad user memory or copyback and fails on bad args or signals.

Leaf-map failure requests retry not error and long loops yield requiring stable re-entry; rollup dropping locks must invalidate iterator and recompute resume to avoid use-after-free or double counting.

invariants.text: Flags show label plus set mnemonics with placeholders and suppressed slots; counters emit resident, PSS, shared/private, referenced, anon, swap and hugetlb in order with rollup extras.
Hugetlb smaps samples under lock charging full size to shared or private; alternate build omits hook; walk table chosen by lock-held state or always global by build.
Clear-refs skips pinned shared writable entries, clears soft-dirty via protect window or swapped state preserving dirty/young on huge, skips frame maps and filters anon versus file areas.
Pagemap entries combine presence, swap, file, soft-dirty, protection, guard and exclusivity with masked frame; holes emit zeros or soft-dirty marks; huge ranges expand to base-page entries.
Pagemap read validates alignment, task size and wrap, normalizes tags under killable lock, walks in fixed chunks with fresh locks, gates frames by privilege and treats full buffer as partial.
Scan classifies empty, present and swapped with written, accessed, file, zero, soft-dirty and guard marks; large adds huge; acceptance uses inversion with must and any-of filtering.
Matches coalesce when contiguous, cap at maximum with truncation and progress, support backout; protection arms level marks, splits partial THP and stops at partial hugetlb flushing armed span.
Scan args need matching size, allowed flags/masks, untagged aligned start and consistent vectors; results stage in bounded buffer with flush and progress; hugetlb holes use huge granularity or no-op.
NUMA records dirty, swap-cache, active, writeback, anon, sharing peak and node excluding non-present or reserved; THP aggregates singly; walk uses read or verified-area locks by state.

locks.text: Smaps and pagemap walks serialize THP attempts with dedicated lock, leaf iteration with mapped lock plus unmap, and hugetlb sampling with huge lock, holding one leaf lock at a time.
Scan holds level leaf locks across classify and arm with lazy batching and mapping write lock for hugetlb arming; mapping write exclusion nests outside huge table locking.
No-MMU iteration pins task and address space holding read protection with terminal position; vmcore callback list mutation and late registration serialize under dedicated mutex.

state_machines.text: Per-area gather skips out-of-range and gate area dropping outer guard while pinned using swap shortcut or hole walk; rollup iterates all resuming after contention by skipping freed or re-entering split.
Pagemap read goes validation through chunked walks to copy advancing cursors; scan goes test to classify to output recording truncation or partial-huge stop; full buffer and limit end with counts.

structs.text: Four walk tables share middle and hugetlb callbacks; two add hole handling; pairs differ only in global read versus verified per-area read mode.
Seq iteration uses start/next/stop/show with private contexts; clear-refs context holds command; scan state holds args, staging vector and cursor; NUMA state pairs iterator with aggregates.
Pagemap entries wrap 64-bit value with entry-counted read state and disclosure flag; pagemap and scan dispatch route middle, hole and hugetlb cases with null hugetlb hook when unsupported.
Vmcore keeps core and notes buffers with current and original sizes, total size with proc entry, device list nodes with buffer and length, disable and open flags, and fixed log prefix.
